value.authenticity_rationale: The pre-image is a declaration-only forward-run compiler-state carrier (MxUnkRecVA 151, prefix) over the shipped source with g_ctrlEdgesB restored to its ordinary owner.  It emits retail's 1094-byte tree erase exactly, except for two mirrored compares: one exchanges a register and a frame slot through the direction bit, the other exchanges two registers through the ModRM fields; both feed a jne, whose mirror is itself.
